title: The Mutual Listening Chamber

features.name: central processor
features.desc-on-touch: A black chip at the heart of the chamber, where all listening converges. It holds the silence between all the voices.

features.name: ascending frequencies
features.desc-on-touch: Towers of wire stacked upward, each one a frequency learning to wait its turn. Together they make a chord of patient silence.

features.name: return trace
features.desc-on-touch: A circuit path that loops back on itself. Speech becomes listening; listening learns to speak again.

features.name: silence register
features.desc-on-touch: A space where the chamber records what it learns from not speaking. The gaps between voices become the grammar of listening.

features.name: listening pin
features.desc-on-touch: A fine point where two currents meet and pause. Neither speaks; both understand. This is the smallest possible agreement.

reverie.title: REVERIE — two people learning not to interrupt
narr: You are both sitting in this chamber, and for a long time
neither speaks. She listens to you not speaking. You listen
to her listening. The silence becomes a conversation more
complex than any words. When she finally breathes, you hear
it as a sentence. You breathe back. It is the only argument
the archive has ever seen that left both sides satisfied.

inscription: here listening learns that it is not the opposite of speech but its deepest form

file.name: Concourse_Recording_Layered_Silence.mp3
file.note: A 40-minute field recording of the chamber at rest. Most of it is quiet. The listening happens in the grain of that quiet.

exits.label: back to the voices that taught listening it could hold silence
into chambers where other senses learn to listen too
